text:
alex: alert — control-plane heartbeat queue steadily climbing in eu-west1, seeing apiserver 429s and controller-manager requeue storms. GPUs provisioning stuck in Pending.

sre-oncall-bot: [ALERT] control-plane-queue-length > 500 (eu-west1) — INC-2026-0318-09 :rotating_light:

Priya: quick check shows etcd leader stepping frequently, leader term increments every few seconds. logs snippet:
```
etcdserver: stepping down from leader, term=1234
raft: heartbeat timeout
```

sam: infra telemetry shows NIC tx drops and 'link flapped' events on 10.240.5.* during the same window. tx_queue overflow on several hosts.

Jordan: did we push any control-plane changes recently? I applied a toleration tweak to a kube-system daemon set ~2h ago.

alex: kube-apiserver minor rollout in eu-west1 at 2026-03-18T01:12Z (devinfra). Might be correlated but not sure.

devinfra: confirmed — apiserver nodes were patched v1.28.4->v1.28.5 for CVE. No controller-manager or etcd changes. Rollout was staggered but within the same 6m window.

Priya: etcd metrics show Disk I/O spike: IOPS ~9k and p99 disk latency ~25ms. Compaction and snapshot activity overlapped with the rollout.

sam: network ops forwarded a BGP reconverge event in eu-west1 core, lasted ~45s, caused ECMP churn. That aligns with leader elections.

Jordan: controller-manager logs: workqueue backpressure, requeues ramping. Many PodCreate events failing with apiserver 429/500 which prevents node claims for GPU provisioning.

alex: proposed immediate actions: 1) pause any further apiserver rollouts in eu-west1 2) temporarily disable GPU autoscaler to avoid a provisioning storm 3) throttle controller-manager reconciliation frequency 4) consider bumping etcd IOPS for short term.

Priya: running a quick probe: `kubectl -n kube-system exec etcd-0 -- curl -s localhost:2379/metrics | grep -i lease` shows lease/grpc latency elevated.

devinfra: pausing remaining apiserver rollouts now. Also preparing a traffic shift to route control-plane reads to eu-central as a fallback.

sam: I can increase gp3 iops on etcd volumes to 15k but it's a costly diff (~+$1.2k/day). Would mitigate disk-latency driven elections. What's the acceptable cost for the incident window?

alex: availability priority: bring control plane stable. Approve temporary iops increase for next 24h. We'll track cost vs. impact and revert after stabilization.

Jordan: short-term controller-manager flags that help: lower `--kube-api-qps`/`--burst` and set `--terminated-pod-gc-threshold` higher to reduce churn. On apiserver side consider reducing `--max-requests-inflight` to avoid overload.

Priya: scheduling etcd snapshot compaction off-peak and setting compaction retention shorter: `ETCD_AUTO_COMPACTION_RETENTION=1h` for now. Also enabling snapshot throttling to smooth disk writes.

sre-oncall-bot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-0318-09 — responders: alex, Priya, sam, Jordan, devinfra. Status: investigating :clipboard:

alex: Applied iops bump and paused autoscaler. Monitoring queue length and leader stability. If leader elections stop and p99 latency drops we'll slowly resume.

sam: after iops bump and pausing rollouts, disk latency p99 down to ~6ms, leader term stable for 3m, queue length decreasing. GPUs in Pending are starting to bind.

Priya: continuing to watch etcd metrics and controller-manager requeues. I'll schedule a follow-up compaction+snapshot in a maintenance window.

alex: plan for postmortem: correlate BGP reconverge, apiserver rollout timing, and etcd compaction schedule. Need to add rollout gating for control-plane when disk/network events are active.

Priya: ack. Also recommend a runbook update: if apiserver patch + compaction + network event overlap, escalate to SRE lead and consider automatic pause on apiserver rollout. :thumbsup:
